sources.title: Regulatory Flood Map (Bylaw Flood Hazard)
sources.scope: Municipal regulatory zones near the four communities plus approximately 400m.
limitations: Metadata identifies 1983 calculation basis.
Municipal planning designations; not the latest provincial physical hazard study.
Clipped and simplified display geometry is unsuitable for exact parcel conclusions.

sources.title: Flood maps and river flows
sources.scope: June 2026 municipal adoption status.
limitations: New regulatory map/bylaw proposals deferred for additional engagement; do not equate final provincial mapping with adopted City regulation.

sources.title: Final flood studies and maps
sources.scope: Bow/Elbow finalized May 15, 2025; Nose/West Nose original 2005, hydraulic levels revised 2012.
limitations: Study dates and mitigation assumptions vary by river.
Regulated flows account for Springbank and Glenmore downstream where applicable.

sources.title: Alberta Flood Hazard public GIS layer
sources.scope: Four communities plus approximately 400m; 1:100 design flood hazard; 162 clipped display features from all 342 qualifying intersecting source IDs.
limitations: Selected Regulated or Natural scenarios; Naturalized comparison and incremental 1:200/1:500 zones excluded.
Provincial hazard layer, not adopted City regulatory zoning.
5m source generalization and further display simplification; no exact parcel conclusions.
Protected flood fringe is a model category, not a safety guarantee.

params.where: Flow_Regime IN ('Regulated','Natural') AND Multi_Zone NOT IN ('1:200 Flood','1:500 Flood')

geometryAudit.explanation: Six generalized interior rings could not be assigned to an exterior ring; all were verified disjoint from the delivered region before exclusion, so they cannot alter the local clipped geometry.

sources.title: 1:100 inundation map
sources.scope: Older scenario based on 2020 mapping.
limitations: Does not substitute for final 2025 Bow/Elbow study.

sources.title: Flood extents from June 22, 2013
sources.scope: Observed flood extent from aerial imagery after peak.
limitations: Not the maximum extent of the entire 2013 event.

sources.title: Noise Exposure Forecast Contours
sources.scope: Five published NEF contour features, citywide.
limitations: Source field dblevel represents NEF contour index, not measured dBA.
2021 AVPA changes referenced by metadata.
Community intersection does not describe every address.

sources.title: Noise Exposure Forecast and Related Programs
sources.scope: Explains modeled aggregate NEF planning metric.
limitations: Not a current sound-level measurement.

sources.title: Airport vicinity protection area
sources.scope: Current guidance on AVPA and 2021 changes.
limitations: Permitted uses and acoustic requirements may involve parcel-specific exceptions; a contour alone does not establish permission.

sources.title: PublicVue flight tracking
sources.scope: Nearly real-time and historical flight replay.
limitations: NAV CANADA flight data via PASSUR platform; flight tracks do not measure indoor noise.

sources.title: Noise data and publications
sources.scope: Noise program reports and studies.
limitations: Each report has its own period and metric; complaint counts are not calibrated exposure measurements.

sources.title: About radon
sources.scope: Testing establishes the concentration in a home.
limitations: No property radon result inferred from community, nearby tests, geology or house characteristics.

sources.title: Guide for radon measurements in residential dwellings
sources.scope: Long-term measurement guidance, including period and tested location.
limitations: Guide defines long-term measurement as at least 91 days and discusses 3–12 month tests and heating-season coverage.
Preserve test dates, room/floor, device, units, result and mitigation evidence.

sources.title: Testing your home for radon
sources.scope: Public guidance recommends minimum three months.
limitations: A short viewing-time reading is not an established annual home result.

sources.title: Air Quality Data (near real-time)
sources.scope: Three source-named Calgary monitoring stations; PM2.5 source-calendar dates August 13 to September 12, 2026 inclusive.
limitations: Near-real-time feed: quality assurance incomplete.
Source timestamp timezone unspecified; do not append UTC Z.
Station names are local identifiers, not a verified crosswalk to ECCC NAPS IDs.
Outdoor station readings do not establish personal or address exposure.
Daily means require all 24 valid hours; null gaps preserved.

query.$select: station_name,parameter,units,latitude,longitude,min(readingdate) as from_date,max(readingdate) as to_date,count(*) as readings

sources.title: Access air data
sources.scope: Official links to current and historical air observations.
limitations: Available source, not a validated multi-year extract in this package.

sources.title: Information for air data users
sources.scope: CSV extraction, quality flags, good-quality selection and query limits.
limitations: Compare equivalent periods, parameters and station histories after extraction.

sources.title: Ambient Air Data Search
sources.scope: Official historical station/parameter data download.
limitations: Validated multi-year data not ingested.

sources.title: National Air Pollution Surveillance Program
sources.scope: Long-term national outdoor monitoring.
limitations: Query tool and downloadable catalogue verified; Calgary annual statistics not calculated here.

sources.title: Parks Sites
sources.scope: Active park-maintenance sites intersecting four communities plus approximate 400m.
limitations: Maintenance-site features are not a count of distinct public parks.
Intersections do not establish entrance location or public access.

sources.title: Parks Pathways
sources.scope: Active Parks Pathways inventory near four communities.
limitations: Not all sidewalks or cycling routes.
Approximate deduplicated mapped length is not walkability or travel time.
Lifecycle and operational status are separate source fields.

sources.title: Parks Amenity Equipment
sources.scope: Active Parks Amenity Equipment near four communities.
limitations: Includes utility equipment; filter type rather than ranking by total count.
Separate inventories are needed for other facility classes.

sources.title: Calgary Bikeways
sources.scope: Separate bicycle-network inventory.
limitations: Not included in packaged pathway-length totals.

sources.title: Pathways Connector Data
sources.scope: Pathway connector inventory.
limitations: Not included in packaged pathway-length totals.

sources.title: Calgary 2025 Orthophoto Web Tiles
sources.scope: Citywide 2025 photography, 7.5cm native resolution, Web Mercator 256px tiles.
limitations: Direct public viewing is described in the City guide; this is not an open-data redistribution licence.
Use City attribution and preserve the photograph year.
3D buildings are a separate overlay, not present in these image tiles.

rightsEvidence.summary: The City guide describes public viewing and web-map use of hosted image services without a viewing licence agreement. Distribution of orthophoto files requires a licence. The 2025 orthophoto is listed without the permission restriction attached to Pictometry and some older years.
rightsEvidence.itemLicenceSummary: Item metadata retains all-rights-reserved copyright language and restricts reproduction without City consent and a licence. Treat the more specific public-viewing guidance as permission for direct service display, not an open-data grant.

excludedResearchScratchFiles.air-pm25-recent-raw.json: Truncated preliminary 10,000-row sample; grouped complete extraction is authoritative.
excludedResearchScratchFiles.alberta-flood-first-page.geojson: Partial first 100 features only; not a complete layer.
excludedResearchScratchFiles.alberta-flood-core-attributes.json: Complete source bounding-box attributes including scenarios not selected in the packaged design layer.
